# Network Operation and Protocol Evolution

Rincoin operates through independently validating nodes, miners, wallets,
exchanges, explorers, and other services using compatible rules. Validating
nodes independently enforce the consensus rules implemented by the software
they choose to run.

Consensus changes require publicly inspectable specifications and software,
testable boundary behaviour, compatible deployments, and voluntary adoption by
network participants. Publication of a draft describes a rule; it does not
activate that rule.
